Gemma 2 Benchmark on Consumer GPUs: 2B Model Hits 120 Tokens/Sec

A community benchmark on r/LocalLLaMA evaluated Google's newly released Gemma 2 2B and 9B models on mid-tier consumer hardware (RTX 3060, Apple M2). The 2B model achieves over 120 tokens/sec under 4-bit quantization, demonstrating near-instantaneous response times for local summarization tasks while consuming only 2.2GB of VRAM.

Ghostty: A Fast, Feature-Rich GPU-Accelerated Terminal Emulator

Mitchell Hashimoto's Ghostty terminal emulator enters public beta. Written in Zig, it leverages the GPU for butter-smooth 120fps rendering, native macOS and Linux tabs, and cross-platform truecolor rendering without battery drain.

PostgreSQL 17 Migration Notes and Performance Under Load

Engineers at a high-scale payments platform shared their experience migrating internal OLTP clusters to PostgreSQL 17. The new memory-efficient vacuum engine cut peak IOPS spikes during high-concurrency writes by 42%.
